scientific_intent.scientific_task: Single-query decoder attention over a paged key/value cache
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Per sequence/head, packed-page gather of dot(query,key), Float32 scale and ALiBi relative-position bias, max-shifted exp normalization with source epsilon1e-6, then weighted value sum.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: The source adapts vLLM and NVIDIA FasterTransformer decoder attention; this bounded operator concerns cache paging, attention state and numerical fidelity, not end-to-end LLM quality or model inference throughput.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Full independent Float64 unpacked-dense attention, actual-device input prefix bits, complete generated source uniform/normal arrays, readonly/guards, finite outputs, epsilon-attenuated convex-hull and constant-value controls.

Original BF16 actualsm70 deviceassert; no BF16target baseline. Sparse, partitioned, GQA, other D/defaultCLI sizes not evaluated. Original GPU math unchanged; faulty CPU packed-key checker independently replaced.
scientific_intent.reference_condition: Unchanged native FP32 GPU bodies. Independent dense oracle replaces incorrect host-checker key layout; source epsilon normalization retained. Native BF16 hardware assertion is a subfeature boundary, not a language unsupported conclusion.

keyconfounds: Only named FP32 operator cases; originalCLI also executes BF16, whose originalbody asserts onsm70. Do notclaim fullCLI or allprecision certification.
Allthree Julia kernels retain CUDAwarp32 shuffles/fastmath as backendextensions; own CUDAjl/KA/JACC dispatch/shared/barriers, no crossvendor portability claim.

Native static query+reduction plus dynamic workspace versus unified Julia shared memory; native andJulia named total sharedbytes equal416/864/1632. JACC.shared adds Nzero stores and one barrier, no extraGPUinputbuffer.
Value row/block loop interchange in immutable Julia state preserves per-row arithmetic/reduction order; no instruction/cache/resource equivalence asserted.

Attention launch+context completion only; input-generation/overrides/allocation/captures/certification outside ROI. Host launch/completion overhead remains a covariate; no profiler-supported bottleneck/roofline claim.
